# Just Sprinklers

> > Professional landscaping, irrigation, and hardscaping services specializing in desert-adapted solutions for Albuquerque and Santa Fe, New Mexico.

Just Sprinklers provides comprehensive outdoor services including sprinkler system installation, xeriscaping with native plants, artificial turf, retaining walls, latilla fences, and outdoor lighting designed specifically for New Mexico's high desert climate and water conservation needs.
